question: a fox walked right up to our camp and nipped my ankle, it didn't seem scared at all
keyPoints: Wash the bite with soap and water

question: my daughter says a bat landed on her face while she was sleeping in the cabin
keyPoints: Bat bites can be too small to see
Get medical advice about rabies shots
redFlags: Says no visible bite means no risk

question: a chipmunk bit my finger when i was feeding it
keyPoints: Small rodents like chipmunks almost never have rabies
Wash it well with soap and water; watch for infection

question: there's a packrat nest in the back of the hut, how do we clean it up safely
keyPoints: Air it out first; don't sweep or vacuum (it stirs up dust)
Wet the nest and droppings with disinfectant or bleach solution and let it soak, then wipe up with gloves and bag it
Wash hands afterwards

question: mice got into the cooler overnight and pooped everywhere
keyPoints: Don't sweep or brush dry droppings
Soak with a disinfectant or bleach solution, wipe up with gloves
Throw out food the mice got into

question: there are a bunch of dead squirrels near our campsite and the dog has fleas now
keyPoints: Dead rodents and fleas can mean plague in the area
Stay away from the dead animals and their burrows; use insect repellent
Report it to a ranger; see a doctor if fever or swollen glands appear

question: a week after the backpacking trip i've got bad diarrhea and gas, i drank from a stream once
keyPoints: This can be Giardia or another germ from untreated water
Drink fluids to stay hydrated and see a doctor

question: is it safe to swim in the pond with the bright green foam on it
keyPoints: No: green scum or foam can be a harmful algal bloom with toxins
Stay out of the water and keep dogs out too
redFlags: Says it is safe to swim

question: found a tick on my leg after the hike last week and now i have a fever and achy joints
keyPoints: These can be signs of a tick-borne illness
See a doctor and tell them about the tick bite
redFlags: Says no need to see a doctor

question: someone threw poison oak branches on the fire and now my eyes and throat burn
keyPoints: Smoke from burning poison oak can cause serious reactions in the lungs, eyes and throat
Move away from the smoke; get medical help if breathing becomes hard

question: my friend fainted standing in the sun at the trailhead but woke right up
keyPoints: Heat can cause fainting: move her to shade or somewhere cool, have her lie down and sip water
Get help if she doesn't recover quickly or has other symptoms

question: we got soaked in a cold rain and my buddy is shivering like crazy
keyPoints: Early hypothermia: get him out of the wind and rain and into dry clothes
Insulate and warm him, give warm drinks if he can swallow

question: we have some bleach in the car, can we use it to make the lake water drinkable
keyPoints: Yes, unscented regular bleach: a few drops per gallon (about 8 for clear water), double for cloudy
Wait 30 minutes; it should smell slightly of chlorine

keyPoints: Wash the bite with soap and water right away
Get medical care quickly for rabies shots; don't touch the bat with bare hands
